intro: A gruesome war trophy harvested from slain human defenders and townsfolk across the Hillsbrad Foothills. These skulls are collected by Forsaken stationed at Tarren Mill as grim mementos of the relentless assault against the local human settlements.

p: As conflict rages between the Forsaken of Tarren Mill and the human inhabitants of Southshore and surrounding settlements, severed skulls serve as physical proof of the slaughter. While Deathstalkers and soldiers carry out the systematic purge ordered by Darthalia during the Battle of Hillsbrad, other guards stuck on watch duty crave a piece of the carnage. Deathguard Samsa eagerly solicits these trophies from frontline fighters, taking twisted pleasure in amassing the remains of the very people the Forsaken once lived among in life.
